headword: {国語教育|こくごきょういく}

definitions.gloss: Japanese-language education; teaching of the national language
definitions.explanation: The teaching of reading, writing, and the Japanese language to native speakers in schools. {国語|こくご} here means the national language, i.e. Japanese, as a school subject.

examples.japanese: {国語教育|こくごきょういく}の{大切|たいせつ}さ。
{小学校|しょうがっこう}の{国語教育|こくごきょういく}が{見直|みなお}されている。
examples.english: Japanese-language education in elementary schools is being reexamined.

examples.japanese: {読書|どくしょ}の{習慣|しゅうかん}をつけることも、{国語教育|こくごきょういく}の{大切|たいせつ}な{役割|やくわり}だ。
examples.english: Instilling a habit of reading is also an important role of Japanese-language education.

notes:
Written {国語|こくご} (national language; Japanese as a school subject) + {教育|きょういく} (education). Distinct from teaching Japanese to foreigners.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日本語|にほんご}{教育|きょういく}: Japanese-language teaching — used for teaching Japanese to non-native speakers
- {国語|こくご}: national language; the school subject "Japanese" — the base term
